chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad transmitted it from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

A supplication to be recited after every prayer you perform. If you have an ailment from sickness and pain, after you complete your prayer, wipe with your hand on the place of your prostration from the earth, and supplicate with this supplication, and pass your hand over the place of your pain seven times, saying: 'O He who pressed the earth onto the water and filled the air with the sky, and chose for Himself the best of names, send prayer upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and do for me such and such, and provide for me such and such, and grant me health from such and such.'
ai.seo_question: What is the prescribed method and text for a healing supplication after prayer in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this supplication emphasizes the spiritual efficacy of post-prayer rituals, linking physical healing to divine remembrance. The invocation highlights God’s creative power by referencing His control over the earth, water, and sky, while prescribing a tactile ritual of wiping the forehead on the earth and the afflicted area seven times to invoke specific blessings.
